candidate.name: custom
candidate.notes: Own typed-array model + Canvas2D renderer with viewport level of detail; no tree or rendering library. Core in src/core (no React), component in src/react.

tipClick.how: pointer hit-test against the frame draw list through a uniform-grid spatial index (tip dot, or the label text box); also Enter on the keyboard cursor

internalNodeClick.how: internal node markers (clades >= 7 px) and collapsed clade triangles are hit-tested; clicking a collapsed clade reports the clade root

branchClick.how: distance to the branch segment (4 px slop): the horizontal branch above a node or the vertical connector of the clade; reported as branchClick with the clade below

hover.how: pointer move is hit-tested once per animation frame; tipHover/nodeHover are emitted when the target changes; built-in tooltip near the cursor and a ring on a separate canvas

descendantTipsInPayload.how: every event carries the descendant tips as the leaf-contiguous range of the preorder TreeModel (O(1) range lookup, then a slice); reported as source=adapter-derived because the data model is our own, not a library payload

cladeColouring.how: colour classes per node index from React state (nested clades: later wins); branches, collapsed triangles, markers and tip labels take the class colour; one canvas redraw, no re-layout

highlightTip.how: translucent row band across tree and columns, ring on the tip, bold primary-coloured label, ticks in the overview strip

focusTip.how: rows set to at least 26 px and the tip centred; the x window moves only if the tip is outside it. Instant when requested through props; animated (220 ms) from the imperative handle

tipAsLink.how: real <a href data-tip-id target=_blank rel=noopener> elements positioned over the canvas text for the rows that have labels (visible rows only, <= 600 DOM nodes), keyboard focusable; rows too small for labels have no anchor (a visually hidden list of the tips in view stands in for them)

customColumns.how: bar (log scale), text and alignment columns drawn on the canvas, pinned to the right edge, windowed to visible rows with header; below 1 px per row bars are binned per pixel row (mean)

alignmentColumn.how: whole alignment rasterised once into an offscreen bitmap (1 px per residue), only visible rows are blitted; > 8M residues falls back to runs for visible rows

radialLayout.how: angle from tip rank, radius from root distance, same layout arrays as rectangular; LOD, culling (sector bounding boxes), hit-testing, labels, overview all work in radial; columns are not drawn in radial

branchLengthToggle.how: phylogram (cumulative length, negative and missing lengths count as 0) versus cladogram (tips aligned); layout recomputed in O(n) and cached for both

scaleBar.how: distance axis with round ticks for phylograms (rectangular), a time-before-tips axis with gridlines when the tree is ultrametric (dated), a round-length scale bar in radial

darkTheme.how: gbifDarkTheme() values (derived from tokens; GBIF defines no dark set) passed as the renderer theme; canvases redraw

cssTokens.how: theme object resolved from gbifTheme() (canvas cannot read CSS variables); runner tokens background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily override

multipleInstances.how: no module state except a text-width cache keyed by font; each instance owns its renderer, DOM and canvases

cleanUnmount.how: destroy(): rAF cancelled, ResizeObserver disconnected, window pointer and font listeners removed, canvases resized to 0, DOM removed

controlledState.how: clades, highlighted tips, columns, layout, lengths, theme, tip links and an optional viewport are props; viewport changes come back through onViewportChange (once per frame)

zoomToFit.how: fits on mount and on layout/length/column changes while the view has not been touched; fit() from the handle, key 0 and double click on empty space; wheel zoom-out stops at 1.6x the tree

overviewOrMinimap.how: overview strip (rectangular, aligned with the rows) or a small disc (radial) drawn once from the LOD cut at fit, with a draggable viewport rectangle; click or drag to move

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.

thresholds.note: unusable = load > 10 s, or > 50% of the time in frames > 50 ms (best of 3 rounds), or > 100 ms main-thread CPU per interaction step, or click latency > 300 ms; p5 FPS is reported (best of 3) but not judged

load.note: os.loadavg()[0] (1-minute); runs with start or end load above 4 are marked noisy
